name: Cotton Rock n Roll 2
summary:
The next Cotton is set in Japan!?

The latest installment of the popular shoot 'em up game series featuring the gluttonous witch Cotton is finally in development! And this time, the adventure will take place in Japan!?

Cotton, dressed as an oiran, will soar through the skies in a brand-new world!
